overal.goal: secureHeaders() default sends Strict-Transport-Security max-age=15552000; includeSubDomains, which nginx forwards, pinning the whole site and every subdomain to HTTPS for 180 days after one visit; Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin is applied to /harness.txt and /llms.txt, which agent tooling fetches cross-origin. Let the proxy own HSTS (disable it when the request arrives via X-Forwarded-Proto, or drop includeSubDomains) and relax CORP on the public docs. The nginx prefix snippet already hides the header; make the default right.
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI, vitest

rules.do: Read README.md and docs/boof-runner.md for the intended behaviour before changing code.
Write a failing test first, then make it pass; keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npm test` and `npm run lint` before finishing.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs/api.md and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.

versions.version: Identified during the 2026-10-27 review; not started.

Strict-Transport-Security (max-age only, no includeSubDomains) is sent only when boof terminates TLS itself and the request did not arrive via X-Forwarded-Proto; /harness.md, /harness.txt and /llms.txt answer Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: cross-origin; hardening.test.ts pins both; deploy docs updated.

tests.strategy: Unit tests with vitest for the changed module; an integration test through the Hono app or CLI where the behaviour is observable there.
